newsitem.title: UK: Portugal tenders to buy one fuel cargo, Malta thre.
newsitem.headline: Portugal tenders to buy one fuel cargo, Malta thre.

text.p: Portugal's state power company Electridade de Portugal (EdP) has tendered to buy a small cargo of 18-22,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil, traders said on Wednesday.
The tender, which is understood to close on March 16, is for delivery into Lisbon by the end of the month.
Malta has also issued its regular three month buy tender for high sulphur fuel. The tender calls for one cargo of 20-25,000 tonnes in April, May and June delivered after the 23rd of each month.
The quality requirement is 3.5 percent sulphur 0.991 specific gravity, 380 centistoke and 150 vanadium.
Traders said the tender closes next week.
